_about: Student self-reflections, Class II (6th grade) coding, end of Q1, fall 2026.  15 students.  De-identified: IDs are arbitrary and not in roster order; the key is kept outside this repo.  Quotes are verbatim but trimmed.  Read alongside 2026-q1_sparky_findings.md.
_lessons: Students used the pre-restructure lesson names.  'lesson' values below use those names; 'current' maps each to the current course (lessons/canvas_import).

lesson_map.unspecified: student did not say which lesson

questions.Q1: One thing in your game you decided on purpose; what can you make the computer do now that you couldn't in September?
questions.Q2: Proudest lesson and how far you got; hardest lesson and what made it work.
questions.Q3: Last time your sketch broke: what you tried first, who/what you turned to, and one kind of problem you want to fix on your own.
questions.Q4: One time Sparky was useful and what helped; one time Sparky was frustrating and what you wished it had done.

_taxonomy: Codes used in sparky_useful.mode and sparky_frustrating.mode.

useful_modes.U-art: Drew or helped draw shapes, backgrounds, decorations, character details
useful_modes.U-mechanic: Helped build a game mechanic (score, win/lose, timer)
useful_modes.U-debug: Found or explained what was wrong in their code
useful_modes.U-blanks: Gave fill-in-the-blank code or made the student type it in themselves
useful_modes.U-questions: Asked step-by-step questions instead of answering
useful_modes.U-experiment: Suggested changing a number and watching what happens
useful_modes.U-retype: Rewrote a whole tab that had many mistakes

frustrating_modes.F-broke-code: Code Sparky gave (or a fix it made) broke something that worked, or had its own errors
frustrating_modes.F-lost-work: Student lost working code after a Sparky change and could not recover it
frustrating_modes.F-invented-bug: Claimed a problem that wasn't there, or admitted to guessing
frustrating_modes.F-spatial: Could not get a drawing request right (shape, direction, placement on the character)
frustrating_modes.F-loop: Repeated the same advice after the student had already done it
frustrating_modes.F-jargon: Used words the student didn't know yet, or gave too much at once
frustrating_modes.F-placement: Student didn't understand where to put the code Sparky gave
frustrating_modes.F-refusal: Declined a request as out of scope or as 'you wouldn't learn'
frustrating_modes.F-dependency: Student says Sparky did too much for them
frustrating_modes.F-communication: Student found it hard to describe what they wanted to an AI

self_fix_goals.G-syntax: Small syntax errors: missing ; or ), doubled or mismatched brackets
self_fix_goals.G-find-error: Working out what and where the error is
self_fix_goals.G-placement: Getting things to show up in the right place
self_fix_goals.G-big-errors: Larger errors that need bigger fixes
self_fix_goals.G-feature: A feature, not a kind of problem (e.g. add music)
